then gives you one drill and one mobility exercise for
the rest of your bucket.

fixed rule table, and an honest “Cannot analyse” when the video
can’t support an answer.

svg.text: how sure it is — on every measurement

text.tspan: Here’s what the video shows. From address to impact your hips
move toward the ball by 7% of your body height. Up to 4% is normal;
past that, the rule table calls it early extension, and in your clip it’s
clear. The most likely reason is that your lead hip doesn’t turn
enough — 31° at impact, where about 45° is typical — so your hips slide
toward the ball instead of rotating. That part is an inference, so it’s
marked medium. It may feel like you stay down, but at impact your
hips have moved toward the ball. For the rest of this bucket, do the
wall drill. Between sessions, the 90/90 hip rotation helps the hip
turn.
Set up with your backside
touching a wall (or golf bag).
Make slow half swings, keeping
your trail glute on the wall
through impact.

g.text: Fixes: hips move toward the ball

text.tspan: Sit with both knees bent at 90°,
one in front, one to the side.
Rotate to switch sides without
using your hands.
Generic guidance, not medical
advice — see a physiotherapist if you
feel pain.

Then the verdict, the fault chain and one
drill — before you’ve hit the next ball.
The rule table covers three common faults you can see down the line.
Anything else gets an honest “No verified fault found”.
Hips move toward the ball between address
and impact.

and impact.

svg.text: from hand path · capped at medium
Then ask your coach about it.

text.tspan: Every result comes with a chat. It answers only from that
analysis — it won’t invent faults, numbers or drills it can’t
point to.
Why does it feel like I’m staying down when I’m
not?
Your chest stays bent over, so it feels like staying down. But
compare the key frames: at impact your hips are 7% of your
body height closer to the ball than at address. The wall drill
makes it feelable — if your trail glute leaves the wall, that’s the
move.

svg.text: Answers are based only on this analysis.
Bring your phone to the range.
